exact_text:
A one-day reversal occurs when the high of the day is
higher than the high of the previous day, but the close of the day
is below the close of the previous day and the volume of the current day is higher than the volume of the previous day.
added_conditions: often happens at the end of a long-term move
high of the day higher than high of the previous day
close of the day below close of the previous day
volume of the current day higher than volume of the previous day

added_conditions: bad news in a bull market climate
